summary: Create a pull secret with oc create secret generic from a .dockercfg (type kubernetes.io/dockercfg) or .docker/config.json (kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson), or with oc create secret docker-registry and server, username, password and email; then link it to the pod's service account with oc secrets link default <secret> --for=pull.
questions: How do I create an image pull secret on OpenShift?
How do I link a pull secret to the default service account?
How do I create a pull secret from config.json?

answer_card.title: Create and link an image pull secret
answer_card.answer_md:
From an existing Docker config:
```
oc create secret generic <pull_secret_name> \
  --from-file=.dockerconfigjson=<path/to/.docker/config.json> \
  --type=kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
```
Without one:
```
oc create secret docker-registry <pull_secret_name> \
  --docker-server=<registry_server> --docker-username=<user_name> \
  --docker-password=<password> --docker-email=<email>
```
Then link it to the service account the pod uses (default `default`):
```
oc secrets link default <pull_secret_name> --for=pull
```
